scope_reviewed: Inventory: places, restaurants, cafés, experiences, events, activities, recurring groups, markets and services
source_alignment.note: Intent semantics and handlers are aligned to the current EyeMakkah consumer prototype information model. This file defines the intent bank only; it does not modify or integrate the app.

purpose: Bilingual discovery and recommendation intent bank for the EyeMakkah consumer assistant. Covers what-to-do, food/cafés, families, visitors/residents, places/activities, accessibility/practical questions, and time/area discovery. Answers are resolved dynamically from current app inventory and user context.

integration_contract.ranking_rule: Use the current app's inventory, promotability/lifecycle state, suitability, time fit, selected area, explicit preferences, Plan/completion state, novelty, community context and existing ranking helpers. Do not invent objects outside the current inventory.
integration_contract.time_rule: Respect current Makkah time and item duration/open-hours data where represented. Do not imply live availability beyond the prototype data.
integration_contract.distance_rule: Use selected neighborhood or granted location context when available. The assistant must still work without precise location.
integration_contract.suitability_rule: Only claim family/kids/solo/women/beginner/accessibility suitability when the object explicitly declares it or has a direct practical fact supporting it.
integration_contract.trust_rule: If practical information is stale/conflicting, carry the trust/freshness warning into the answer rather than presenting certainty.
integration_contract.result_rule: Prefer 1–3 actionable EyeMakkah objects or a composed outing instead of generic paragraphs.
truthfulness: Do not claim live crowding, inventory, seats, parking, or booking availability unless a real source exists.
Do not present a generic/context image as proof of an exact place.
Do not infer sensitive traits from behavior.
Do not collapse Save, Add to Plan, Join, Booking, Confirmed, Active, or Completed.
Do not mark external booking confirmed after handoff alone.
Do not recommend expired offers, ended events, or dormant/paused recurring groups as active options.

bank_plan.planned_part_03: Offers/discounts, booking/actions, Plan operations, community participation and multi-step outing actions.
bank_plan.planned_part_04: Conversation follow-ups, aliases, entity routing, contextual suggestions and short-session memory.
